D.treatment: interactive video zone 0 plus instructor-led zone 1

O.outcome_detail: full CPR checklist competence after zone 1 training

cells.quote: After zone 1 training, 100% (28/28) of the experimental group achieved competence vs 84% (16/19) of the control group (P=.06, Fisher exact test).
cells.note: The study states that all participants had no prior CPR training; the intervention combined a self-directed interactive-video session with a 4-hour instructor-led seminar, whereas the comparison received the seminar only.

D.treatment: traditional blackboard lectures with professor body language visible

O.outcome_detail: perceived interest and preference for the teaching modality

cells.quote: In the same ex ante online survey (AS1) the students also expressed a clear preference for traditional lectures at the blackboard, confirming that the body language of the professor is important and that the possibility to see the professor renders the lecture more interesting.
cells.note: The finding is based on an online questionnaire rather than random assignment. The study reports a preference, not a standardized effect size.

D.treatment: option to attend lectures in person when traditional lectures are possible

O.outcome_detail: acceptability of attending lectures only online

cells.quote: Based on the results presented in Table 2 and in order to overcome the shortcomings of the purely online emergency teaching of the second semester 2019/2020, and taking also into account the updated national and regional regulations that permit regular teaching activities under certain conditions, the Department of Civil, Environmental and Mechanical Engineering (DICAM) adopted the strategy for the first semester of the academic year 2020/2021 detailed in the next section.
cells.note: In Table 2, 263 students answered no and 162 answered yes to considering attendance only online acceptable when traditional lectures would again be possible. The study does not report an effect size or inferential test.
